title: Quick German Pretzel Wrap
description: Fermented, chewy German-style pretzel wrap infused with Thai panang curry paste and fresh pickles, served on a ti leaf for a sugar‑free, weeknight crowd‑pleaser.
instructions: Combine flour, yeast, and salt in a bowl and add warm water to form a dough.
Cover the dough and let it ferment for 20 minutes until it has visible bubbles.
Stir in baking soda, panang curry paste, and chopped pickle until evenly distributed.
Roll the dough into a thick rope and shape it into a long oval around the ti leaf wrap.
Heat a nonstick skillet over medium heat and add a splash of sesame oil.
Place the shaped dough on the skillet and cook for 4 minutes on each side until golden and crispy.
Slide the cooked dough onto the ti leaf, folding the leaves around the dough to form a wrap.
Serve immediately while the pretzel remains warm and chewy.
